about_the_game:
In Realms Road, travelers will visit different lands. Each land has its own objectives. Most of the objectives are optional but very rewarding. The main goal of travelers is to end the corruption in the realms and slaughter all the monsters they encounter on the map. At the end of each map, you will travel to the GATEWAY OF REALMS. Here, you can develop your champions in your own unique way with the gold, talent books and monster essences you earn. Your party will need to solve puzzles and pass traps to complete some maps. Travelers have tried to survive this adventure, otherwise they will have to start over from the beginning if they do not have enough gold and realm stones.

Realms Road offers a unique gameplay style for every player, with its diverse map missions, deep character customization, and champion combinations.

content_descriptors.notes: Some of the 2D visuals designed in the game include semi-nudity, but no genitals are shown. Since the game is a war-themed game, there is light violence, but nothing extreme. It does not contain any substance use.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Microsoft Windows® 10/11 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4340 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Compatible OpenGL / VRAM 1GB or better
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
